name: Electric Field
description: Charge-gradient intelligence mediating force between charged bodies. Governs signal propagation, potential difference, and electromagnetic coupling.

core_attributes.pattern: charge gradient, field line propagation, potential difference

scope.definition: Fractional accuracy of Coulomb's law in describing electrostatic force between point charges — deviation of measured force from F=kq₁q₂/r² across 15 orders of magnitude in charge separation.

evidence.source: Cavendish (1773) original verification; Williams et al. (1971) 'New experimental test of Coulomb's inverse-square law', Physical Review Letters 26:721-724.
cross_domain_examples: Coulomb's law verified to 1 part in 10¹⁶ — most precisely confirmed inverse-square law in physics
photon mass upper bound < 10⁻⁵⁴ kg confirmed by galactic magnetic field observations — explains why Coulomb's law is exact
gravitational inverse-square law: same mathematical form verified to 1 part in 10⁴ at human scales
atomic orbital energy levels: Coulomb's law predicts H atom spectrum to 10⁻¹² accuracy (quantum corrections)

scope.falsifiability: If measured electrostatic force deviates from F=kq₁q₂/r² by more than 1 part in 10⁶ at any accessible scale, Coulomb's law requires modification.
scope.measurement_limits: Near-perfect precision applies only to point charges in vacuum — in dielectric media, effective permittivity modifies the force constant. Quantum corrections become significant below 10⁻¹⁵ m.
